title: Strategy and creativity, measured in results.
paragraphs: I'm a digital marketer who works where content, community and performance meet. From planning a month of social posts to scaling a Meta Ads campaign, I treat every channel as part of one growth system.

My work starts with the audience: what they search for, what makes them scroll past and what earns their trust. From there I build campaigns, optimise for search and keep reporting honest, so decisions come from data, not guesswork.
portraitAlt: A wine-red chess king beside a target, a rising arrow and growing bar chart

principles.title: Audience first
principles.text: Every plan begins with the people it needs to reach and the problem it solves for them.

principles.title: Built to convert
principles.text: Content and ads are designed around a clear next step: a follow, a lead or a sale.

principles.title: Measured weekly
principles.text: Transparent reporting that shows what's working, what isn't and what changes next.
